summary: Anteris Technologies Global Corp. filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026 disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary Anteris Aus Operations Pty Ltd amended its May 24, 2024 Supply Quality Agreement with Harvey Industries Group Pty Ltd. The September 22, 2026 amendment extends the agreement's term until the earlier of December 31, 2026 or execution of a replacement supply and quality agreement; all other material terms remain unchanged. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine supply-contract extension, not a special situation. Watch for execution of the replacement agreement; no risk-arb angle applies.
